The uncomfortable truth

AI Changed SEO. Agencies Need a New Approach to Selling SEO Services.

AI has changed how agencies deliver SEO and how Google surfaces results, and search platforms like ChatGPT and Claude are taking a growing share of queries. That's where blended search comes in. We can't call it "SEO" anymore, we need to start treating search more holistically, as an umbrella term that covers:

  • Local Service Ads
  • Traditional PPC ads
  • AI Overviews
  • Local map pack results
  • Traditional website results
  • ChatGPT, Claude & other AI platforms
The problem
SEO is fragmented and doesn't drive clicks.

People are still searching as much as ever, but AI is absorbing a lot of the clicks and the rest is spread across ads, organic, and AI platforms. Traditional SEO, sold the traditional way, doesn't send your clients enough traffic to get real results.

The fix
Sell a "blended search" model that drives results.

The blended search model goes after ads, organic, and AI platforms at once and builds visibility across every channel. That's how you keep delivering strong results for your clients, and it's how your agency keeps growing.

This proposal suite lets you analyze and sell SEO, local SEO, ChatGPT GEO, PPC, and LSA deals, all in one place. It's done for you, tested, and proven. We're using it right now to sell $8,000-a-month search retainers and get strong results for those clients.
